description: For each pending state (Edit with N assigned 999 on row 1; AddNew with ID 20 and N 999 assigned) and each operation [Requery ;; Clone ;; assign Filter ;; assign Sort ;; OpenRecordset ;; FindFirst "N = 40" ;; assign Bookmark (2,2,0,0) ;; Move 0 ;; MoveNext ;; MoveLast ;; read RecordCount ;; GetRows(1) ;; Edit again ;; AddNew ;; Delete ;; Update ;; Close the recordset ;; db.Execute UPDATE of the same row ;; db.Execute INSERT of another row ;; BeginTrans then Rollback]: fresh dynaset over F with held Fields ID and N, enter the pending state, run the operation, then read EditMode, Errors, N, then CancelUpdate, EditMode and Errors; release derived objects and close. Asks which operations a pending Edit or AddNew accepts, refuses, posts or discards, and the buffer afterwards. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
